wins.label: Running category momentum
wins.evidence: Running was a standout field of play for the quarter, growing mid-single digits...Peg 41 is continuing to drive healthy volume in all geos

wins.label: Brand activation success at major events
wins.evidence: Our NIKE San Francisco flagship store had its best commercial day in 10 years...we saw lines down the block all weekend

wins.label: Digital repositioning progress
wins.evidence: NIKE Digital in North America went from over 30 promotional days to 0...resulted in a several percentage point improvement in demand at full price

wins.label: New product innovation traction
wins.evidence: Early seed pairs nearly sold out across the North American marketplace...The first month of sales in 24/7 have exceeded our expectations

wins.label: Wholesale partner realignment
wins.evidence: we see the declines in Classics Footwear franchises almost being offset by growth in performance dimensions...our partners are coming behind us

risks.label: Severe revenue decline and margin compression
risks.evidence: revenues were down 9% on a reported basis and down 7% on a currency-neutral basis...Gross margins declined 330 basis points to 41.5%

risks.label: Greater China deterioration
risks.evidence: In Greater China, Q3 revenue declined 15%...traffic declined double digits and retail sales underperformed our plan...EBIT declined 42%

risks.label: Classic franchises inventory overhang
risks.evidence: Air Jordan 1 and Dunk remain elevated with continued actions planned ahead...we intend to drive this mix lower in fiscal '26, with total units planned down double digits

risks.label: Elevated inventory and liquidation headwinds
risks.evidence: inventory remains elevated across all geographies...we are liquidating inventory...we expect that, that's going to take us several quarters to work through

risks.label: Q4 guidance weakness and macro uncertainty
risks.evidence: We expect Q4 revenues to be down in the mid-teens range...We expect Q4 gross margins to be down approximately 400 to 500 basis points...geopolitical dynamics, new tariffs, volatile foreign exchange rates
